title: Pylons — Aft Fairing Heat Shield — Replacement by a Titanium Item on VDK-56B Installations
abstract: Replacement of the aluminium pylon aft fairing heat shield by a titanium item with lengthened standoffs, released to the two VDK-56B operators whose hot-and-high findings launched the campaign.

sections.planning_reason: Thirty-eight findings of distorted pylon aft fairing heat shields have been reported on VDK-56B installations over four years, eleven of them showing fastener pull-through at the standoff feet. A detached shield in this position is a foreign object risk to the thrust reverser and drives an unscheduled removal of the aft fairing to inspect. Skin temperature surveys measured peak values twenty-five degrees above the qualification temperature of the aluminium item during prolonged ground running.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin removes the aluminium heat shield and installs a titanium item of the same external profile on lengthened standoffs that increase the ventilation gap by eight millimetres. The obsolete forward attachment angle is deleted and the load is taken directly into the fairing frame with countersunk screws at a closer pitch.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowls and remove the pylon aft fairing from zones 433, 443 and 481. Put the fairing on a bench. Remove the aluminium heat shield and the obsolete angle D5450007427818. Inspect the fairing frame for heat distortion and elongated holes, and report any finding before you continue. Drill the closer screw pitch using the template supplied. Install the fitting D5450130082174 with the lengthened standoffs and check the ventilation gap at four positions. Install the titanium shield and fasten with the screws AES177340K7 to the torque values given in the accomplishment instructions. Re-drill the brackets of the indicator FIN 299PP and the handle assembly FIN 70PP to clear the new standoff line. Re-install the fairing, close the fan cowls and do a ground run to confirm there is no fouling. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to VDK-56B powered ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft operated by Chinook Pacific and Emerald Coast Air. These are the two operators whose findings launched the change and who funded the first tranche of kits. Any other operator wanting the modification asks for an extension of effectivity through its customer support office.
sections.material_note: Kit K5450-1027-01 contains the titanium shield, the standoff set and the screws for one pylon. Two kits are required per aircraft. Lead time is twelve weeks. The removed aluminium shield is scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next A check, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

title: Pylons — Aft Fairing Heat Shield — Replacement by a Titanium Item on VDK-56B Installations

issue.reason: The effectivity is widened from the two launch operators to the whole remaining VDK-56B population so that a second campaign can be quoted against it.

abstract: Replacement of the aluminium pylon aft fairing heat shield by a titanium item on lengthened standoffs, re-issued with effectivity over the whole remaining VDK-56B population rather than the two launch operators.

sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to all ZEPHYR-18, ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft with VDK-56B engines that are not yet at the titanium shield standard, whoever operates them. The original effectivity named only the two launch operators; it has been widened because the remaining population is the population the second campaign is aimed at, and quoting against the narrow effectivity would have excluded most of it. Aircraft with VDK-12 engines are not affected because the VDK-12 nacelle uses a different aft fairing with an integral shield.
sections.material_note: Kit K5450-1027-01 contains the titanium shield, the standoff set and the screws for one pylon. Two kits are required per aircraft. Lead time is twelve weeks, and the widened effectivity means the kit is now forecast against the whole VDK-56B population rather than against two operator fleets, so order early in a campaign slot. The removed aluminium shield is scrapped locally.
